app.name: MyMedia
app.tagline: Your photos and videos, organized in your Google Drive

auth.signInHint: MyMedia only talks to your own Google Drive. Nothing is stored on any other server.
auth.reconnectTitle: Google connection needs to be renewed
auth.reconnectText: Your work is kept and will continue after you reconnect.
auth.scopeDenied: MyMedia needs access to your Google Drive. Please sign in again and tick the Drive permission.
auth.popupBlocked: The Google window could not open. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
auth.configMissing: The app is not configured yet: the Google client ID is missing in config.json (see the setup guide).

setup.title: Welcome to MyMedia
setup.noRoot: No "{{name}}" folder was found in your Google Drive. MyMedia will create it.
setup.rootMissingText: The "{{name}}" folder was deleted or moved to the trash in Google Drive. Restore it from the Drive trash, or create a new one.

folders.deleteText_one: The folder and its {{count}} file go to the Google Drive trash. You can restore them from there for 30 days.
folders.deleteText_two: The folder and its {{count}} files go to the Google Drive trash. You can restore them from there for 30 days.
folders.deleteText_other: The folder and its {{count}} files go to the Google Drive trash. You can restore them from there for 30 days.
folders.exists: A folder with this name already exists here.

gallery.emptyHint: Add photos or videos to the "{{name}}" folder in Google Drive, then press “Load new files”.

sync.scanning: Reading your Drive folders… {{done}} files found

viewer.cannotPlay: This video cannot be played in this browser.
viewer.cannotShow: This photo format cannot be shown in full quality in this browser.
viewer.deleteText: The file goes to the Google Drive trash. You can restore it from there for 30 days.

settings.title: Settings
settings.rootFolderHint: Renaming changes the folder name in Google Drive.
settings.syncAutoHint: Checks when the app opens, then regularly while it is open.
settings.rescanHint: Only needed if something looks wrong.
settings.clearThumbs: Clear thumbnails, previews and videos kept on this device

errors.syncFailed: Loading from Google Drive failed. It will be retried.
errors.metaUnreadable: mymedia.json in your Drive cannot be read. It was not changed. Restore a previous version from Google Drive (right-click → Manage versions).

classify.introClassify: Media at the root of the main folder, or in a category without an album. Tap the suggested album to move the file there, or choose another one.
classify.introAuto: MyMedia moved these files by itself because it was confident. Check them: confirm, or choose the right album.
classify.noSuggestion: No suggestion yet (learning in progress, or not enough examples).
classify.keepHereHint: Leave this file where it is; no more suggestions for it.
classify.autoSetting: Move files automatically when MyMedia is confident
classify.autoSettingHint: Only to albums with at least 3 example photos. Below that, MyMedia only suggests.
classify.rebuildHint: Learning runs by itself in the background after each load.
classify.learningHint: MyMedia studies your photos to recognise new ones. Nothing leaves your device.

stats.title: Learning statistics
stats.overall: Overall accuracy: {{percent}} (each photo tested against all the others)
stats.fewHint: With fewer than 3 photos, an album only gets suggestions, never automatic moves.

skip.videoNotHere_one: {{count}} video: compress it on a computer (Chrome or Edge)
skip.videoNotHere_other: {{count}} videos: compress them on a computer (Chrome or Edge)
skip.format_one: {{count}} HEIC/PNG photo (conversion to JPEG is off)
skip.format_other: {{count}} HEIC/PNG photos (conversion to JPEG is off)

compress.background: You can close this window: compression continues in the background (progress at the top).
compress.autoTitle: When big new files are found in Drive
compress.autoHint: Files you already had stay as they are: use the Compress button on an album to compress them. Videos are compressed only on a computer.
compress.convert: Convert HEIC and PNG photos to JPEG
compress.videoHint: Video compression needs a computer with Chrome or Edge. On phones, videos wait until the app is opened on a computer.

keep.version: Replace it (Drive keeps the old version about 30 days)
keep.both: Keep it forever in the file’s version history

keepHint.version: Saves the most space. The original can be recovered for about 30 days: in Drive, right-click the file → File information → Manage versions.
keepHint.folder: The original is copied to MyMedia/_Originals/… before compression. No space is saved until you delete that folder.
keepHint.both: The original stays as an older version of the same file, without time limit. No space is saved.

compress.minGain: Keep the file unchanged if it saves less than
compress.offerIntro: These new files are big. Tick the ones to compress:
compress.uncheckedHint: Unticked files will not be proposed again (you can still compress them later with the Compress button).

autoMode.ask: Show me the list and let me choose (recommended)

import.title: Add photos and videos
import.intro: Choose photos and videos from this device, a USB stick or an SD card. MyMedia uploads them to Google Drive with their real date.
import.dateHint: The date is taken from the photo (EXIF) or the video recording, else from the file name, else from the file itself — not the upload date.
import.analyzing: Reading dates and checking for duplicates… {{done}} / {{total}}
import.duplicatesHint_one: {{count}} file is already in your Drive (same photo): unticked.
import.duplicatesHint_other: {{count}} files are already in your Drive (same photo): unticked.
import.compress: Compress before upload (faster upload, less space)

faces.nameHint: Typing a name that already exists merges the two groups (same person).
faces.facesHint_one: The face MyMedia recognised as this person. If it is not them, tick it to fix it.
faces.facesHint_other: The {{n}} faces MyMedia recognised as this person. Nothing to do if they are right; if a face is not them, tick it to fix it.
faces.toNameHint: Each picture is a group of faces MyMedia thinks belong to the same person. Open one and give it a name: it will be applied to all their photos, and to new ones.
faces.searching: MyMedia is looking for faces in your photos (progress at the top).
faces.noneHint: Faces are searched for during learning, after "Load new files".
faces.introText: MyMedia looks for faces in your photos and videos and groups those of the same person. You give each group a name ("Mom", "Noa"…), then you can see all the photos of a person, and new photos are named automatically.
faces.introPrivacy: Everything happens on this device. Face data is never sent to any service; it is saved only in your own Google Drive (mymedia-faces.json) to share it between your devices.
faces.deleteAllText: All faces, groups and names are deleted from this device and from your Drive (mymedia-faces.json). Your photos are not touched. If recognition stays on, faces will be searched for again.

filters.searchPlaceholder: Search: name, description, album, person, species…

select.title: Selection
select.newAlbumTitle_one: New album with the selected file
select.newAlbumTitle_other: New album with the {{count}} selected files

facebook.hint: Facebook export: on Facebook, "Download your information", HTML format, then choose the ZIP file you received. Each photo keeps the date and text of its post; photos already sent are unticked.
facebook.notExport: This ZIP is not a Facebook export in HTML format (group_posts_and_comments.html not found).
facebook.unreadable: This ZIP file cannot be read.
facebook.speciesHint: When the text of a post contains the name of an album of the destination (a species), the photo goes straight into that album. The others stay in the destination, and MyMedia suggests a species.
facebook.matching: Looking for the photos Katia reduced… {{done}} / {{total}}
facebook.replaceHint_one: {{count}} photo of the ZIP will replace its version reduced by Katia (left picture → right picture). Species, album, date and text stay; Drive also keeps the old version. Untick a line if it is not the same photo.
facebook.replaceHint_other: {{count}} photos of the ZIP will replace their version reduced by Katia (left picture → right picture). Species, album, date and text stay; Drive also keeps the old version. Untick a line if it is not the same photo.

katia.settingsHint: First move Katia's folder (birds / ציפורים) inside the MyMedia folder in Google Drive. MyMedia then reads its myphotos.json: species, date, text and group of each photo.
katia.title: Bring in the Katia data
katia.searching: Looking for myphotos.json in your Drive…
katia.error: Something went wrong. Check the connection and try again: what is done stays done.
katia.notFound: No Katia myphotos.json file was found in your Drive.
katia.nothingToDo: The Katia data is already in: nothing more to do.
katia.moveFirst: Katia's folder "{{name}}" is not in MyMedia. In Google Drive, drag it into the MyMedia folder, then come back here.
katia.toReview_one: {{count}} photo without a species: it stays in the category, MyMedia will suggest one ("To classify")
katia.toReview_other: {{count}} photos without a species: they stay in the category, MyMedia will suggest one ("To classify")
katia.unmatched_one: {{count}} photo of the folder is not in myphotos.json (unchanged)
katia.unmatched_other: {{count}} photos of the folder are not in myphotos.json (unchanged)
katia.trashEmptied_one: Move the Katia folder that will be empty to the trash
katia.trashEmptied_other: Move the {{count}} Katia folders that will be empty to the trash
katia.safe: Photos are moved, never copied or deleted. myphotos.json stays in Drive. A photo you already filed yourself in MyMedia is not moved.
katia.keepOpen: Keep MyMedia open and the screen on. If it stops, open this window again: filing resumes where it stopped.
